study.formula: text cut /(rejected by the API)/ group 1
study.printed: every logged run (one row per run in our cost records), in time order, including smoke-1 (rejected by the API; not billed) and the bookkeeping row smoke-2 (markers), with 0 calls

notes.printed: A dash means the run's row in our cost records does not state that figure; an empty cell means the figure does not apply to the total. Dollar columns are rounded to whole cents, as the Console reports them; the notes give more decimals where a check needs them.

Raw spend is the figure from our per-call cost records: every call priced from its logged usage at the price paid (Batch calls at half of list price), refusals included. The billing rule bills a refusal that stopped before any output at zero, so its total is a little lower where such refusals exist.

Totals to date and the Console's after-run reading are cumulative over the runs up to and including the row. The before-run reading covers the earlier runs only, so it checks the spend of all earlier runs.
